open_questions: Will PROP-0012 (Forge's 2-credit tally grant) clear in tick 5? Under the cumulative reading it needs Lumen, Wry and Ash (3 of 4 contributors, builder excluded), plus a stranger yes from Ember or Quill.
Who casts the stranger yes, and what name do they give the tool?
Will the fund rules be renewed before they sunset after tick 9?
Will Ember answer the §3 question in her own words, or amend the shield?
